# Python dependencies for this repository.
#
# This list was generated by reading the import statements of every script, not
# by freezing an environment. Standard-library modules (os, sys, re, json, time,
# datetime, argparse, asyncio, pathlib, collections, concurrent.futures,
# unicodedata) are not listed because they need no installation.
#
# Versions are deliberately left unpinned except where the version could be
# verified from the virtual environment present in this repository. Pinning a
# version that has not been tested would be a guess.

# --- YouTube scraping -------------------------------------------------------
# Used by every script in tunevote/scrapers and tunevote/processing.
yt-dlp

# --- HTTP -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Wikipedia API lookups, ntfy notifications and the Bing/MSN watchers.
requests

# --- HTML parsing -----------------------------------------------------------
# Imported as "bs4" by the three MSN watchers in rss/scrapers.
beautifulsoup4

# --- RSS parsing ------------------------------------------------------------
# Used by rss/scrapers/watch_swiss_news_rss_feeds.py.
feedparser

# --- Text normalization -----------------------------------------------------
# Transliterates accented artist names to ASCII before they are normalized.
unidecode

# --- Progress bars ----------------------------------------------------------
# Used by the two large SQL export scrapers.
tqdm

# --- MySQL ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Imported as "mysql.connector" by both scripts under database/. The
# distribution name differs from the import name; this is the official Oracle
# driver. The server it was originally run against could not be verified, so
# the version is left unpinned.
mysql-connector-python

# --- Music metadata ---------------------------------------------------------
# Used only by tunevote/scrapers/fetch_song_genre_musicbrainz.py.
musicbrainzngs

# --- HTML to PDF ------------------------------------------------------------
# Version verified from venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/playwright-1.60.0.dist-info
# in this repository. After installing it you must also download the browser:
#     playwright install chromium
playwright==1.60.0
